subject.title: Race condition (missing tool result / synthetic errors) still reproducible on 2026.6.11 AND 2026.7.1-beta.2 — supersedes closed #31664/#6682/#15008/#13286

question: Is the open flush-boundary PR plus its current proof enough to own this issue, or do maintainers require a live long-session Feishu/mmx reproduction before accepting the fix shape?
rationale: The current code path still matches the reported race surface, but the best fix and proof bar for a long-session session-state bug need maintainer judgment because the supplied production trajectory is private and the linked PR is proof-gated.

options.title: Require live production-path proof
options.body: Keep this issue open and require the linked fix candidate to show a live or artifact-backed long-session/channel reproduction before merge.

options.title: Accept focused unit proof
options.body: Let the linked PR proceed if maintainers consider the one-tick flush-boundary tests sufficient for this race class.

options.title: Reject the defer approach
options.body: Pause the linked PR and ask for a broader session-state design if maintainers believe one event-loop tick is too narrow for the reported long-session failures.

recommendation.title: Require live production-path proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require the linked fix candidate to show a live or artifact-backed long-session/channel reproduction before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The session tool-result guard history makes this the best available routing owner for deciding proof sufficiency on the synthetic-result behavior.
